seo_title: Cost of Living in Skopje 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Skopje per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The capital of North Macedonia in the Balkans: visa-free entry for Russians, some of the lowest prices in Europe and a warm climate. The downsides are a small job market, modest infrastructure and winter smog.
pros: Some of the lowest prices in Europe
A warm climate and greenery all around

visa_steps.title: Renting a home

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Skopje?
faq.answer: A visa-free regime applies for tourist trips — check the current allowed duration before you go.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Skopje?
faq.answer: Some of the lowest prices in Europe. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Skopje?
faq.answer: Macedonian (close to Bulgarian and Serbian); English is understood among younger people.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Skopje?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You need denars and a foreign bank card.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Skopje?
faq.answer: Continental-Mediterranean: hot summers and cool winters, sometimes with smog.

faq.question: Why move to Skopje?
faq.answer: Cheap living in Europe, visa-free entry, a warm climate and a relaxed Balkan pace.

reviews.text: Skopje surprised me with how cheap it is: Europe on a shoestring, warm and green. The downsides are the small job market and winter smog, but it's peaceful and visa-free.
A compact, cosy city with friendly people. The prices are a pleasure and the Balkan atmosphere is lovely. What's missing is international services and direct flights.
